findings: Official thread/delete now hard-deletes active or archived rollouts, spawned descendants, and associated state including thread-linked logs and memory extraction state.
Official list, read, search, rename, archive, unarchive, resume, fork, turn control, and experimental item pagination overlap normal session-management features.
Official memory controls support per-task use/generation choices and full reset, but no supported per-entry view/edit/delete contract was found for consolidated memory.
fixes: Repositioned the project around independent delete verification, recoverable cleanup, legacy or damaged-state audit, and recovery.
Added a tracked official-capability replacement baseline to the compatibility release gate.
Deferred new normal thread-management tools, custom MCP cursor handoff, direct memory mutation, and broad Amp exploration.
postFixVerification: The compatibility validator requires capability records to match the pinned stable Codex version and review date.
README and roadmap distinguish official-first workflows from retained project responsibilities.
Memory guidance uses official controls and does not recommend direct database or generated-file mutation.
